insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured + Booster+ Sum Insured + Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured (exact amounts as per Policy Schedule)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.
great.explanation: No room rent limit is mentioned, so you can choose any room category. This avoids room-rent caps that can reduce claims, but a higher room can still consume your Sum Insured faster.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: Sum Insured will be utilized as per following sequence in event of any claim: 1. Base Sum Insured 2. Booster+ Sum Insured 3. Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured
great.explanation: Claims are paid in a defined order—Base Sum Insured first, then Booster+ Sum Insured, then Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured. This creates extra insurer-funded coverage layers that can kick in after the base cover is used up.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.
great.explanation: After the first paid claim, ReAssure “Forever” gets triggered and continues for life as long as you renew without a break. This can provide repeated replenishment of cover for future claims across policy years.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are not covered for the first 36 months of continuous coverage from the policy start date. You can claim for PEDs only after completing this 3-year waiting period.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Listed specified diseases/procedures are not covered for 24 months from the first policy inception. Claims for these conditions become payable only after 2 years of continuous coverage.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident, provided the same are covered.
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered in the first 30 days from the first policy commencement date, except accidents (if covered). This means non-accident medical issues arising in the first month are generally not payable.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay expenses incurred on consultations, medicines, physiotherapy, diagnostic tests for 60 days before the date of admission and 180 days after date of discharge
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for 180 days after discharge (and pre-hospitalization for 60 days before admission). This is a standard follow-up window for medicines, tests and consultations after a hospital stay.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment: It is the percentage of admissible claim amount You would have to bear, Rest we will pay.
bad.explanation: Only a definition of co-payment is provided here, and no applied co-pay percentage/trigger is stated in this extract. With no applied co-pay clause shown, the insurer should pay 100% of admissible claims, which is better than plans that charge 10–20% co-pay.

unclear.name: NCB
unclear.quote: Cumulative Bonus means any increase or addition in the Sum Insured granted by the insurer without an associated increase in premium
unclear.explanation: Only the definition of Cumulative Bonus is provided, without the accrual rate, maximum cap, or what happens after a claim. You’ll need the policy schedule/benefit table to know how much extra Sum Insured you can earn and whether it reduces or resets on a claim.

unclear.name: Consumables
unclear.quote: Claim Safeguard: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I – Expenses not covered’ of Annexure I’... Claim Safeguard+: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I,II,III,IV of Annexure I’.
unclear.explanation: Consumables/non-payable items are covered under Safeguard or Safeguard+ as per the specified Annexure lists. It’s unclear from this extract whether either of these is included by default or only if selected, which changes whether consumables are payable in your plan.

unclear.name: Restore Limit
unclear.quote: Maximum amount ReAssure+ pays for any single claim is up to Base Sum Insured.
unclear.explanation: Even if restore is described as unlimited, the maximum payable from ReAssure+ for any single claim is limited to the Base Sum Insured. This affects large single hospitalizations where the restore layer may not fully cover the excess beyond the base limit.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless claim facility is available at our network hospitals ONLY. As list of network hospitals is dynamic, for the latest list, refer to our website www.nivabupa.com.
unclear.explanation: Cashless is available only at the insurer’s network hospitals, and the list is maintained on the website. The document doesn’t state the number of network hospitals, so the breadth of cashless access can’t be judged from this extract.
